learned_patterns.pattern: Inspect shared packages directly before writing a gap analysis; the registry describes capability, not tenancy shape. grep for the tenant model found the single most plan-changing fact in the whole analysis.

task_history.summary: Business analysis for ConnectBPM: audit-grade mid-market wedge, ops-leader buyer, BPMN-semantics-not-BPMN-authoring, instance-metered pricing, 3-pillar MVP. Found zero tenancy in shared packages -> tenancy is a BUILD gating all pillars.
